newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 7.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Former French presidential security force members allegedly involved in recruiting mercenary forces to support Zairean army men in their fight against rebels.
-- Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer in an article says the planned new euro currency should enjoy the same stability as the mark.
-- Semi-conductor maker SGS-Thomson reaches ninth world ranking according to Dataquest.
-- Dutch services group Vendex buys interim work firm Bis, new group to be world's third largest actor in sector.
-- Generale des Eaux to disengage from catering subsidiary Generale de Restauration in which it holds a 47.7 stake.
-- Naval shipyards seek state help to survive defence sector restructuring.
